name: Vega RBCC reference and cycle-code comparison pack
provenance: Primary NASA Technical Reports Server records and abstracts; the source-specific quantitative test data are not bundled.

architecture.source_note: The NASA A5 concept record describes integrated rocket thrusters and an inlet, isolator, airbreathing combustor and nozzle flowpath, four operating modes, and demonstrated AAR-to-RAM and RAM-to-SCRAM transitions in tests. This is an architecture reference, not a performance map for Vega.

mixing_model.source_note: NASA's THRSTER description uses a quasi-one-dimensional three-stream marching model and stipulated mixing rates. Vega does not infer mixing rates from this abstract.

validation_requirements: primary rocket mass flow and chamber state
wall static pressure taps along mixer and combustor
limits: The Mach cases are code-comparison conditions, not one vehicle trajectory.
Evaluated free-stream values use Vega's selected altitude for side-by-side screening; source-specific test altitudes are not implied.
No measured performance coefficients or mixing rates are supplied by this pack.
A case match does not calibrate Vega or establish operability.
